steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals

steps.title: Who else makes it

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: Cyclophosphamide is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale sites hold 20.4 and 21.6 days on hand; the label traces supply to a plant with a VAI inspection known 2026-07-14

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include cyclophosphamide as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 54 vials of the 2 g/100 mL presentation at 2.7 vials per day, providing 20.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 62 vials of the same presentation at 2.9 vials per day, providing 21.6 days on hand.
The product label for NDC 65219013320 names Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (Jinqiao Road Site) as a registered plant for analysis, API manufacture, manufacture, and pack.
FDA inspection 1319132 at that plant ended 2026-04-15 with a VAI classification and was known to FDA on 2026-07-14.
The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked 2 is Avenacy, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses plant EPIC PHARMA LLC.
Check current allocation and lead time from Avenacy, LLC and confirm whether the VAI inspection at the Jiangsu Hengrui site affects supply continuity.
